title: Magic Kingdom Magic
intro: [excited] Welcome in, and welcome to the most magical place on Earth! Today's whole board is Magic Kingdom: the princess who owns the castle, the lands, the mountains and a little bit of real magic. [whispers] Keep your hands, arms and buzzers inside the vehicle.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A breathtaking fairy-tale castle with blue spires at night, bursting fireworks overhead, a glowing tree-lined avenue leading to it, magical sparkles in the air.

categories.title: Bibbidi-Bobbidi-Boo
categories.intro: Our film category belongs to the princess with the castle in the middle of the park... [excited] Cinderella!

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A sparkling glass slipper on a velvet cushion beside a large orange pumpkin, a grand clock about to strike midnight, swirls of blue fairy dust.

clues.clue: Cinderella's Fairy Godmother turns this vegetable into a shining coach.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a pumpkin! [chuckles] Great for coaches, pies and Halloween. Very versatile vegetable.

clues.clue: Cinderella's magic spell wears off at this time.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is midnight! [dramatic] Bong, bong, bong. Cinderella was the original Cinderella story about curfews.

clues.clue: Cinderella's mean stepsisters are named this pair.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Anastasia and Drizella! [sarcastic] Two left feet, two sour attitudes, zero glass slippers.

clues.clue: Disney's Cinderella premiered in this year, helping rescue the studio's finances after World War Two.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 1950! Cinderella was a smash hit, and the studio's bank account got its own happily ever after.

clues.clue: Cinderella's loyal horse, who the Fairy Godmother turns into a coachman, is named this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Major! [laughs] Bruno the dog becomes the footman. Pretty big promotion for both of them.

categories.title: Lands Ahoy
categories.intro: Next, Lands Ahoy! Do you know which Magic Kingdom land is which?

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. An illustrated treasure-map style overhead view of a theme park with a castle hub, jungle, western town, colonial square and futuristic spires, compass rose in the corner.

clues.clue: Guests walk down this turn-of-the-century street from the entrance toward Cinderella Castle.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Main Street, U.S.A.! [whispers] Look up at the upstairs windows, they honor the people who built Disney.

clues.clue: Space Mountain blasts off in this Magic Kingdom land.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tomorrowland! [dramatic pause] The future that never was, but always will be. Deep, right?

clues.clue: At Magic Kingdom, Pirates of the Caribbean sails in this land.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Adventureland! [mischievously] At Disneyland the pirates live in New Orleans Square instead. Sneaky pirates.

clues.clue: Magic Kingdom's Haunted Mansion is spooking guests in this colonial-themed land.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Liberty Square! [chuckles] Its Mansion is in a Hudson River Valley style. The ghosts love a good colonial vibe.

clues.clue: Above Tomorrowland, guests take a slow elevated tour on the Tomorrowland Transit Authority this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is PeopleMover! It's the most relaxing ride in the park, and it even peeks inside Space Mountain.

categories.title: Zoomed-In Magic
categories.intro: Time for Zoomed-In Magic! I'll start SUPER zoomed in on a piece of Magic Kingdom and slowly zoom out. [whispers] Buzz in once you know the spot.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A vintage brass magnifying glass hovering over a twinkling theme park at dusk, the lens revealing sharp magical details while the rest is soft and blurry.

clues.clue: Name this Magic Kingdom landmark.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Cinderella Castle! It's about 189 feet tall, and it's a little taller than it looks thanks to forced perspective.

clues.clue: Name this Magic Kingdom ride.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Mad Tea Party! [laughs] Spin the wheel in the middle as hard as you dare. Lunch afterward is not recommended.

media.prompt: Extreme close-up, original painterly digital illustration, no people, no characters, no logos, no text. Giant pastel teacups with swirled patterns on a spinning platform under colourful paper lanterns and a striped festival canopy.

clues.clue: Name this Magic Kingdom attraction.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Haunted Mansion! [whispers] Nine hundred ninety-nine happy haunts, but there's always room for one more.

media.prompt: Extreme close-up, original painterly digital illustration, no people, no characters, no logos, no text. A stately red-brick Gothic manor with a tall tower and dark slate roof at dusk, wrought-iron fence, crooked tombstones and a lone hearse carriage on a winding path.

clues.clue: Name this Magic Kingdom attraction.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Jungle Cruise! [mischievously] Home of the worst puns on Earth. I'm a fan, obviously.

media.prompt: Extreme close-up, original painterly digital illustration, no people, no characters, no logos, no text. A small striped-canopy riverboat with a rusty tin roof and a rope-wrapped wheel, gliding down a muddy jungle river past huge leaves and a wooden dock with crates.

clues.clue: Name this Magic Kingdom ride.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Prince Charming Regal Carrousel! Its horses were hand carved in 1917, and it has been turning in Fantasyland since 1971.

media.prompt: Extreme close-up, original painterly digital illustration, no people, no characters, no logos, no text. Ornate white carved carousel horses with gold manes and jewelled saddles, under a gilded canopy with painted panels and warm twinkling lights.

categories.title: Mountain Range
categories.intro: Our Disney Parks category: Mountain Range! It's all about Magic Kingdom's coasters and mountains.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A dramatic skyline of theme park mountains: a white cone-shaped space dome, red rock western buttes with mine tracks and a gem-filled mine entrance, at sunset.

clues.clue: This indoor coaster rockets through the dark like you're flying through outer space.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Space Mountain! [excited] Hold on tight, the stars are closer than they look.

clues.clue: This Fantasyland coaster's mine cars pass a sparkling diamond mine full of singing workers.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Seven Dwarfs Mine Train! The cars swing side to side. Heigh-ho, heigh-ho!

clues.clue: This Frontierland coaster calls itself the wildest ride in the wilderness.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Big Thunder Mountain Railroad! [sarcastic] A runaway mine train, and no one is driving. Totally fine.

clues.clue: In 2024, Tiana's Bayou Adventure opened in the building that used to house this log flume ride.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Splash Mountain! [laughs] Tiana kept the big drop, so yes, you're still going to get soaked.

clues.clue: Magic Kingdom's Space Mountain opened in this year, two years before Disneyland's version.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 1975! Disneyland got its Space Mountain in 1977. Florida was first to the stars this time.

categories.title: Abracadabra
categories.intro: And the fan category: Abracadabra! [mischievously] Magic spells, magic objects and magic makers from Disney films.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A wizard's workshop with a glowing star-covered pointed hat, a dancing broom, buckets of water, a magic mirror and a floating carpet, swirling blue sparkles.

clues.clue: Aladdin and Jasmine fly over the world on this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the magic carpet! [laughs] A whole new world, with no seat belts.

clues.clue: The Evil Queen asks this who is the fairest one of all.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Magic Mirror! [whispers] Never ask a question you don't want answered honestly.

clues.clue: Mickey Mouse brings a broom to life, with very messy results, in this segment of Fantasia.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Sorcerer's Apprentice! Mickey learned the hard way. Never skip your chores with magic.

clues.clue: In Beauty and the Beast, the enchanted rose blooms until the Beast reaches this birthday.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is his 21st birthday! [dramatic] If he can't learn to love by then, he stays a beast forever. No pressure.

clues.clue: The sorcerer Mickey works for in Fantasia has this name, which is Walt Disney spelled backward.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Yen Sid! [excited] Spell it backward and you get Disney. Even the wizards love Walt.
